note: Written 4 Sep 2026. Not a house. It is on the node because the node's own prose names the professional line -- Latrobe, Strickland, Walter -- that 'produced the banks', and this is the bank; the Wikipedia article describes the north and south fronts as eight Doric columns over a stylobate of steps under a triglyph frieze.
